message:
Store Git checkout markers outside working trees (#21891)

By storing an `.ok` file in the Git checkout root, uv can collide with
an `.ok` file in the checkout. Store the marker a directory up,
`<commit>.ok` instead of `<commit>/.ok`, to avoid potential collisions.

Fixes #21857.
